notes: Curated working archive: retained V75 editable checkpoint, separate P85 technical control, original addon 0.1.3, retained V14/V15/V16 candidates, source inputs and selected evidence.
All authored Python, JavaScript module, shell, Markdown and text records are retained. Historical scripts can refer to discarded trials and are not all runnable from the curated tree.
All 112 unique Blender scenes (127 paths) remain lossless in the unchanged companion archive because retained scenes depend on its delta chain.
Large superseded renders, raw diagnostic arrays, generated variants and duplicate diagnostic packages are removed from this checkout. CURATION.json records every omitted path and its hash.
The complete previous snapshot is recoverable from commit ca59e222b086e76e6065fe1a884ab852e682dcc6 without rewriting history.
V15 shared-mask 2048 is a retained research candidate, not approved art. V16 depth3 is a locally improved diagnostic and its restored-transparent control is a counterexample, not a release.
No runtime assets, public identities, world data, save migration or release eligibility are changed.
